title: Jerked Potato Gratin
description: A flavorful twist on a classic gratin dish, this recipe combines the spices of jerk seasoning with the comfort of potato.

ingredients.name: Jerked jubilant
ingredients.notes: use the spice blend to season the dish

ingredients.name: Gratin
ingredients.notes: use the grated cheese to top the potatoes

instructions: Peel the Slovakian potatoes and slice them thinly.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Sprinkle a pinch of jerked jubilant over the potatoes.
Repeat the layers until all potatoes are used, finishing with a layer of potatoes on top.
Sprinkle the grated gratin cheese over the top layer of potatoes.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
